QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`src/inference/llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) returns `{}` when `tokenizer_` is unset, and otherwise copies the vector through.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the backend returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, and `{}` on failure from the tokenizer. It never says the backend wrapper's failed-tokenization value is the same as its no-tokenizer value. It also doesn't say the two cases can't be told apart.
